findings_closed.title: Production gates did not know about newly found safe-min / reserve boundaries
findings_closed.resolution: M20F route-freeze input and live collector now require explicit safe value bounds: BuybackBurn route ATH notify upstream value >= 40,000,000 nanotons, Vault ATH deposit owner request value >= 50,000,000 nanotons, and username mint owner request value >= 50,000,000 nanotons. Missing or unsafe values keep M20F blocked.

findings_closed.title: On-chain manifest hash alone does not prove bound counterpart addresses match the manifest
findings_closed.resolution: Added mainnet:genesis:verify, a final getter-vs-manifest verifier. It compares final manifest status/hash, code hashes, seal flags, and bound counterpart addresses across Vault, CapsuleHub, UsernameRegistry, BuybackBurn, FeeAccumulator, and ATHMaster before mainnet genesis can be treated as verified.

findings_closed.title: Historical CURRENT_CODE_HASHES_M19G/M19H artifacts could be mistaken for current release evidence
findings_closed.resolution: Historical milestone-specific CURRENT_CODE_HASHES_M19G/M19H files now carry explicit DEPRECATED_HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT markers pointing operators to artifacts/CURRENT_CODE_HASHES.txt as the only canonical current code-hash source.

production_note: Production remains blocked until final mainnet inputs, M20F STON.fi route evidence, final genesis manifest, funding proofs, and the new mainnet genesis getter-vs-manifest verifier all pass.
